mapper.insert:
insert into gc_access(id,master_id,role_type,admin_id,code,group_name,subject_json,must_subject_json,may_subject_json,update_time) VALUES
(
#{item.id},
nextval('gc_access_id_seq'),
#{item.masterId},#{item.roleType},#{item.adminId},#{item.code}, #{item.groupName}, #{item.subjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.mustSubjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.maySubjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, now())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET master_id = excluded.master_id, role_type = excluded.role_type, admin_id = excluded.admin_id, code = excluded.code, subject_json = excluded.subject_json, group_name = excluded.group_name, must_subject_json = excluded.must_subject_json, may_subject_json = excluded.may_subject_json, create_time = now()

insert into gc_access(id,master_id,role_type,admin_id,code,group_name,channel_json,subscribe_json,subject_json,update_time) VALUES
(#{item.id},#{item.masterId},#{item.roleType},#{item.adminId},#{item.code}, #{item.groupName}, #{item.channelJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.subscribeJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, #{item.subjectJson,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler}, now())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET master_id = excluded.master_id, role_type = excluded.role_type, admin_id = excluded.admin_id, code = excluded.code, subject_json = excluded.subject_json, group_name = excluded.group_name, channel_json = excluded.channel_json, subscribe_json = excluded.subscribe_json, create_time = now()
mapper.select: select COUNT(case when role_type=0 then 1 end) as adminNum, COUNT(case when role_type=1 then 1 end) as userNum, COUNT(case when code_type=1 then 1 end) as subjectAdminNum FROM gc_access WHERE master_id=#{masterId}
mapper.sql: a.id, a.master_id, a.role_type, a.admin_id, a.code, a.subject_json, a.update_time, a.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM gc_access a WHERE master_id=#{masterId} AND subject_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb(#{subjectId}::integer)

SELECT a.*,s.id as img_id, s.name as img_name, s.file_url as img_file_url, s.save_type as img_save_type, s.file_type_index as img_file_type_index,s.file_type as fileType FROM gc_access a left join sys_file s on s.id = a.package_img_id where a.package_name is not null and a.master_id=#{masterId} order by a."order"

SELECT count(gcca_may.id) + count(gcca_must.id) as subjectNum, ac.id, ac.master_id, ac.role_type, ac.admin_id, ac.code, ac.package_learning_hours, ac.subject_json, ac.update_time, ac.create_time, ac.code_type, ac.free_flag, ac.package_name, ac.channel_json, ac.group_name, ac.subscribe_json, ac.role_json, uap.may_subject_json as may_subject_json, uap.must_subject_json as must_subject_json FROM gc_access ac LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua ON ac.id = ua.access_id AND ua.user_id = #{userId} left join gc_user_access_permission uap on uap.user_access_id = ua.id left join gc_content_group_course_assignment gcca_must on ac.id = gcca_must.content_group_id AND gcca_must.is_mandatory = 1 left join gc_content_group_course_assignment gcca_may on ac.id = gcca_may.content_group_id AND gcca_may.is_mandatory = 0 WHERE ac.master_id = #{masterId} AND ac.group_name IS NOT NULL AND ua.user_id = #{userId} and (ua.role_json::text like '%groupMember%' or ua.role_json::text like '%groupAdmin%')
and concat('%',#{name},'%')
GROUP BY ac.id, uap.id order by ac.group_name asc
